schemaNote: GPIR content-factory contract. This file defines shared vocabulary and metadata requirements for future records; it does not publish content or replace the existing country, announcement, source or registry datasets.

recordRules.sourceUrl: Required when source is supplied; use HTTPS and preserve the original publisher URL.
recordRules.publicationDate: Required when the cited source has a publication date; use YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
recordRules.retrievalDate: Required when a source is reviewed; use YYYY-MM-DD.
recordRules.evidenceClassification: Required for published research claims; distinguish FACT, DATA, ANALYSIS, ESTIMATE and FORECAST.
recordRules.unsupportedFreshness: Do not use live, real-time, hourly or continuously updated as a content-freshness claim without verified ingestion evidence.
